title: Need for Speed Underground 2 online in the browser
why_read: A fun technical feat of reverse-engineering an old game's multiplayer to run in-browser, interesting mainly for emulation/networking enthusiasts.
analysis: This project appears to resurrect online multiplayer for a 2004 racing game inside a web browser, likely using emulation or protocol reimplementation techniques. It is the kind of nostalgia-driven reverse-engineering project that shows off real skill in network protocol analysis and browser-based emulation. The high comment count on Hacker News suggests strong nostalgia appeal rather than deep technical novelty for most readers. It is a fun curiosity more than a broadly applicable engineering lesson.
